facts.claim: Borealis (Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines): Entered service 1997; 61,849 GT; 1350 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 238 m length; ex-Rotterdam class.
Borealis GmbH is an Austrian plastics manufacturer that is the second largest producer of polyolefins in Europe, as well as a leader in the petrochemicals industry.

catalogSpecs.description: Formerly Amsterdam, now sailing for Fred. Olsen with traditional British style.
